_comment: Citation for the Leagues of Votann Judgement Token bookkeeping. The current 10e Wahapedia text for Votann describes Prioritised Efficiency / Yield Points — the codex replaced the old Eye of the Ancestors attack re-roll rule mid-edition. The simulator retains the judgement_tokens dict (Army.judgement_tokens keyed by enemy unit uid) as a marker store only — no re-roll buffs are applied from the token count. The dict is populated by _maybe_award_judgement_token (on unit kills) and serves as the eligibility gate for the Ancestral Sentence stratagem dispatcher. VOTANN-DIAG-2 (2026-05-26) removed the last old-edition buffs when confirming on Wahapedia that the army rule is now Prioritised Efficiency.

simulator.judgement_tokens.rule_name: Prioritised Efficiency (Leagues of Votann army rule, 10e)
simulator.judgement_tokens.quoted_text: The current army rule is Prioritised Efficiency: LEAGUES OF VOTANN units gain one of two abilities based on Yield Points. Hostile Acquisition (fewer than 7YP): +1 to Hit rolls against enemies near objective markers, re-roll Advance and Charge rolls. Fortify Takeover (7+ YP): +1 to Hit when attacking from controlled objectives, subtract 1 from Wound rolls for non-VEHICLE units from super-heavy attacks.
simulator.judgement_tokens.trigger: always-on for LEAGUES OF VOTANN armies, switching between modes based on Yield Points accrued at end of Command phase
simulator.judgement_tokens.effect: APPROXIMATION: the Yield Point economy (objective control tracking per round) is not modelled by the simulator. The judgement_tokens dict is retained as a unit-marker store for the Ancestral Sentence stratagem gate only. No attack re-roll buffs are applied — those were from the retired Eye of the Ancestors mechanic removed in iter25 (units.py) and VOTANN-DIAG-2 (stratagems).
